# Failure simulation

What the design does in each failure scenario, computed from [landscape.yaml](../../enterprise-architecture/landscape/landscape.yaml). The database primary starts in DC1.

| Scenario | Verdict | Quorum | Primary | Sync replica | Serving | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Normal operation | **ok** | dc1, dc2, hq | dc1 | yes | dc1, dc2 | Everything that needs to reach everything else still can. |
| Direct DC1–DC2 fiber cut | **ok** | dc1, dc2, hq | dc1 | yes | dc1, dc2 | DC1 and DC2 still reach each other through HQ: replication and cross-site traffic continue over the 10 Gb/s links. Nothing fails over. |
| Direct DC1–DC2 fiber cut, with an out-of-band witness | **danger** | dc1, dc2, hq | dc1 | no | dc1 | Both datacenters still see the witness but not each other. Every quorum member reports healthy, so nothing fails over. Meanwhile the primary has lost its synchronous replica and keeps writing alone (RPO is no longer zero), and dc2 can no longer reach the primary, so its applications fail readiness and it is withdrawn. A second failure now loses data. |
| HQ lost | **ok** | dc1, dc2 | dc1 | yes | dc1, dc2 | Quorum continues with two of the three voting sites, and nothing fails over. There is no tolerance for a second failure until HQ is back. |
| DC1 lost (the primary site) | **degraded** | dc2, hq | dc2 | no | dc2 | The primary in dc1 lost quorum or its site; the synchronous replica in dc2 was promoted, and the old primary fenced itself. dc2 serves production alone, at the planning peak if needed (RES-03), with test and acceptance suspended. The primary runs without a synchronous replica (non-strict mode): a class A incident until it is rebuilt (RES-05). |
| DC2 lost (the replica site) | **degraded** | dc1, hq | dc1 | no | dc1 | dc1 serves production alone, at the planning peak if needed (RES-03), with test and acceptance suspended. The primary runs without a synchronous replica (non-strict mode): a class A incident until it is rebuilt (RES-05). |
| DC1 isolated (both its WAN links cut) | **degraded** | dc2, hq | dc2 | no | dc2 | The primary in dc1 lost quorum or its site; the synchronous replica in dc2 was promoted, and the old primary fenced itself. dc2 serves production alone, at the planning peak if needed (RES-03), with test and acceptance suspended. dc1 is still up but can't reach the primary, so its applications fail readiness and global load balancing withdraws it (RES-02, RES-06). The primary runs without a synchronous replica (non-strict mode): a class A incident until it is rebuilt (RES-05). |
| HQ lost, then the fiber is cut (two failures) | **outage** | none | none | no | none | No database node has quorum: writes stop everywhere. No split brain, but an outage until a human intervenes. |
